name: South Carolina

flag.description: An indigo blue field with a white palmetto tree in the centre and a white crescent in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: The crescent comes from the 1775 flag of Colonel William Moultrie's troops, and the palmetto recalls the palmetto-log fort that withstood a British fleet in 1776.

hook: South Carolina is just a white palmetto tree and a crescent moon on indigo, no seal, no words.
trivia: The soft palmetto logs of Fort Moultrie absorbed British cannonballs during the battle of Sullivan's Island in 1776.
The palmetto tree was added in January 1861, weeks after South Carolina seceded from the Union.
